components.name: Compact Action
components.description: Quiet inline action for panel headers and secondary terminal commands.
components.html: <button class="ds-compact-action">OPEN RANKING<svg aria-hidden="true" width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="m14 7 5 5-5 5"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-compact-action { display:inline-flex; min-height:32px; align-items:center; gap:7px; border:0; border-radius:6px; padding:0 9px; background:transparent; color:var(--muted); font:600 10px/1.25 var(--font-geist-sans),system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.08em; transition:color .16s ease,background-color .16s ease; } .ds-compact-action:hover { color:var(--cyan); background:rgba(94,227,220,.06); } .ds-compact-action:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-compact-action:active { background:rgba(94,227,220,.1); }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: A restrained square control for refresh, favorite, and dismiss actions.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" aria-label="Refresh data"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M20 7v5h-5M4 17v-5h5"/><path d="M6.1 9a7 7 0 0 1 11.4-2L20 9M4 15l2.5 2a7 7 0 0 0 11.4-2"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { display:flex; width:34px; height:34px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:7px; background:transparent; color:var(--muted); transition:color .16s ease,background-color .16s ease,border-color .16s ease; } .ds-icon-button:hover { color:var(--text); background:rgba(255,255,255,.04); border-color:rgba(148,163,184,.28); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-icon-button:active { background:rgba(255,255,255,.065); }

components.name: Control Field
components.description: Compact search and selection field within a dense data panel.
components.html: <label class="ds-control-field"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m20 20-4-4"/></svg><input aria-label="Search trader" placeholder="Address or name" /></label>
components.css: .ds-control-field { display:flex; min-height:36px; align-items:center; gap:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:7px; background:var(--panel-2); padding:0 11px; color:var(--text); font:400 12px/1.5 var(--font-geist-sans),system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-control-field input { min-width:0; flex:1; border:0; outline:0; background:transparent; color:inherit; font:inherit; } .ds-control-field input::placeholder { color:#657083; } .ds-control-field:hover { border-color:rgba(148,163,184,.28); } .ds-control-field:focus-within { outline:2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Selected Navigation
components.description: The selected desktop navigation item with a quiet cyan wash.
components.css: .ds-nav-selected { position:relative; display:flex; min-height:36px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; border:0; border-radius:6px; padding:0 12px; background:rgba(94,227,220,.07); color:var(--cyan); font:500 12px/1.25 var(--font-geist-sans),system-ui,sans-serif; transition:background-color .16s ease,color .16s ease; } .ds-nav-selected:hover { background:rgba(94,227,220,.1); } .ds-nav-selected:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-nav-selected:active { background:rgba(94,227,220,.14); }

components.name: Live Status Chip
components.description: A compact connection state reserved for verified live data.
components.css: @keyframes ds-live-pulse { 0%,100% { opacity:.45; transform:scale(.88); } 50% { opacity:1; transform:scale(1); } } .ds-status-chip { display:inline-flex; height:30px; align-items:center; gap:7px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:999px; padding:0 10px; color:var(--cyan); font:700 9px/1.25 var(--font-geist-sans),system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.08em; } .ds-status-chip i { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--cyan); animation:ds-live-pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-status-chip i { animation:none; } }

components.name: Gain Direction Badge
components.description: A tight directional badge for long and positive states.
components.css: .ds-side-badge-gain { display:inline-flex; min-width:46px; height:21px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border-radius:4px; background:rgba(94,227,220,.09); color:var(--cyan); font:700 9px/1.25 var(--font-geist-sans),system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.04em; }

components.name: Loss Direction Badge
components.description: A tight directional badge for short and negative states.
components.css: .ds-side-badge-loss { display:inline-flex; min-width:46px; height:21px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border-radius:4px; background:rgba(255,104,136,.09); color:var(--loss); font:700 9px/1.25 var(--font-geist-sans),system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.04em; }

components.name: Instrument Panel
components.description: The flat, hairline-bounded container used for rankings, feeds, and market data.
components.css: .ds-surface { overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; background:var(--panel); color:var(--text); font-family:var(--font-geist-sans),system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-surface header { display:flex; min-height:56px; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); padding:12px 16px; } .ds-surface strong { display:block; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; } .ds-surface small { display:block; margin-top:2px; color:var(--muted); font-size:10px; } .ds-surface button { border:0; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:var(--muted); padding:7px 9px; font-size:10px; } .ds-surface button:hover { color:var(--cyan); background:rgba(94,227,220,.06); } .ds-surface button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-surface-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:32px 1fr auto; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:11px 16px; font-size:12px; transition:background-color .16s ease; } .ds-surface-row:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,.025); } .ds-surface-row span { color:var(--muted); font-family:var(--font-geist-mono),monospace; } .ds-surface-row output { color:var(--cyan); font-family:var(--font-geist-mono),monospace; }

components.name: Performance Tooltip
components.description: A transient chart readout that earns elevation over dense plotted data.
components.css: .ds-chart-tooltip { width:max-content; min-width:144px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); border-radius:12px; background:rgba(16,24,39,.95); padding:8px 12px; box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.38); color:var(--text); font-family:var(--font-geist-sans),system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-chart-tooltip small { display:block; color:var(--muted); font-size:10px; } .ds-chart-tooltip strong { display:block; margin-top:4px; color:var(--cyan); font:600 14px/1.25 var(--font-geist-mono),monospace; }

narrative.overview:
DC Pulse is a compact, HyperStats-like intelligence terminal for a curated set of strong traders. It should feel near-black, flat, dense, restrained, and built for repeated professional use: the interface gets out of the way while evidence, comparisons, and live actions remain immediately scannable.

The visual system expresses confidence through disciplined hierarchy rather than decoration. The turquoise ribbon mark is the primary identity asset, while cyan is reserved for positive, live, and selected states. Oversized pill controls, inflated card dashboards, excessive gradients, glass effects, and loose spacing are explicit anti-references.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black terminal surfaces separated by hairline rules.
Compact controls and dense data rows with clear alignment.
Cyan for verified positive, live, or selected states; red for loss.
Geist for interface language and Geist Mono for financial data.
The turquoise ribbon mark remains intact and is never replaced by a letterform.

rules.name: The Signal Color Rule
rules.body: Cyan means positive, live, or selected; red means loss. Neither color is general decoration.

rules.name: The Near-Black Field Rule
rules.body: Build hierarchy with adjacent dark tones and hairline rules, not with bright cards or ornamental color blocks.

rules.name: The Data Has a Different Voice Rule
rules.body: Financial values and addresses use Geist Mono; explanatory language stays in Geist.

rules.name: The No Hero Type Rule
rules.body: This is an operating terminal, so headings establish hierarchy without displacing data from the first viewport.

rules.name: The Scan Before Scroll Rule
rules.body: The first viewport should reveal identity, market context, the strongest comparison evidence, and live state without oversized controls or decorative whitespace.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces use tone and borders; shadow appears only when a transient chart layer needs functional separation.

rules.name: The Compact Instrument Rule
rules.body: A radius describes component scale and purpose; it never turns every control or container into a large soft pill.

dos: Do keep the first viewport dense with trader identity, comparable evidence, and live state.
Do use cyan only for positive, live, or selected states, and red for losses or negative performance.
Do use hairline borders and neighboring dark tones to organize panels, rows, tables, and charts.
Do keep financial values and wallet addresses in Geist Mono.
Do preserve the turquoise ribbon logo's shape and proportions as the primary brand mark.
Do maintain the same complete workflow on phone and desktop through reflow and scrolling.
donts: Don't create oversized pill buttons, giant controls, or inflated dashboard cards.
Don't use decorative gradients; chart area gradients are allowed only when they encode positive and negative performance.
Don't use glass effects on ordinary surfaces or substitute shadow for structural borders.
Don't loosen spacing until the interface reads like a marketing dashboard instead of an intelligence terminal.
Don't spend cyan on ornamental accents, neutral actions, or arbitrary emphasis.
Don't replace the ribbon mark with initials, a monogram, or a generic crypto symbol.
